verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in His mighty expanse.
verses.textZh: 你們要讚美耶和華！在神的聖所讚美他！在他顯能力的穹蒼讚美他！

verses.text: Praise Him for His mighty deeds; Praise Him according to His excellent greatness.
verses.textZh: 要因他大能的作為讚美他，按著他極美的大德讚美他！

verses.text: Praise Him with trumpet sound; Praise Him with harp and lyre.
verses.textZh: 要用角聲讚美他，鼓瑟彈琴讚美他！

verses.text: Praise Him with timbrel and dancing; Praise Him with stringed instruments and pipe.
verses.textZh: 擊鼓跳舞讚美他！用絲弦的樂器和簫的聲音讚美他！

verses.text: Praise Him with loud cymbals; Praise Him with resounding cymbals.
verses.textZh: 用大響的鈸讚美他！用高聲的鈸讚美他！

verses.text: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!
verses.textZh: 凡有氣息的都要讚美耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華！
